title: Marketing copy does not talk about exporting organization data
description:
The organization already runs in the customer's AWS account, so they have the data the whole time. Copy that talks about exporting or archiving an account implies Chatticus is holding the files and handing them back. That is the wrong model.

Known offenders on the marketing site:
- Evidence card title **Archive your account, anytime** and body **documented, exportable data** (`web/components/Evidence.tsx`)
- Hero proof line **Your data. Your move.** (`web/components/Hero.tsx`) if it still reads as taking data out

The lock-in argument stays: data is not trapped behind an API only Anthus controls. Recast it as already-in-your-account, not exportable-on-request.

Scan other visitor-facing `web/` copy (home, /beta, /features/*, FAQ). Leave TypeScript `export`, Next `output: "export"`, waitlist CLI CSV export, and infra docs alone.

```gherkin
Feature: Delegation ladder positioning

  Scenario: The home page does not describe organization data as something to export
    Given the chattic.us home page
    Then it does not describe bots, conversations, or files as exportable
    And it does not offer to archive the account as a way to get the data
    And it states that organization data already lives in the customer AWS account
```
